capabilities: Sorts files and folders together alphabetically in the file explorer
Reverses the mixed order with File name (Z to A)
Sorts case-insensitively and naturally, so Note 2 comes before Note 10
Restores folders-first order when the plugin is disabled
extras: Changes only the sidebar display; no files, folder contents, filenames or vault settings are modified. It hooks Obsidian's internal getSortedFolderItems method, verified against version 1.15.1, so future Obsidian updates may require an adjustment.
intentEvidence: Files and folders now participate in the same alphabetical order, within each folder
problem: Obsidian's file explorer always puts folders above files, so a folder's files and subfolders cannot be read in a single alphabetical sequence.
summary: Plugin that sorts files and folders together in one alphabetical order in the file explorer, instead of listing folders first.
